scope: Static review of draft fitter93 and reviewed caller/helper source only. No fitter execution, auxiliary query/label/receipt-payload read, training, scoring or marker creation. This is separate from the future actual PRE-FIT review.

findings.title: The auxiliary case SHA is not yet bound to the sealed curator payload
findings.evidence: The fitter checks a caller-supplied --aux-cases-sha256, source scope, counts and equality of projected public requests. It does not compare that SHA to a case member/extraction attestation bound to the reviewed curator seal/archive. The complete source registration transitively names source metadata, but no current check links the training-reference file bytes to that sealed payload.
findings.poc: Synthetic unchanged request and identical path/source hash: moving the null-entity anchor from line1 to line2 flips eligible_owner labels [1,0] to[0,1]. request_for_case stays identical. A new CLI SHA for the changed references remains self-consistent with the present code checks. No actual auxiliary file was opened or changed.
findings.impact: Self-consistency alone cannot establish that the96 training judgments are precisely the independently curated sealed pilot. This is a pre-fit provenance closure gap, not evidence that any current judgment was changed.
findings.required_closure: After the source-only review permits the next phase, bind the exact auxiliary cases/public requests to the immutable archive and curator seal through the approved member hashes or a separately reviewed extraction/normalization attestation. Include that binding in the exact reviewed pre-fit manifest. Do not open the sealed payload during the source-only phase.

findings.title: Per-repository request and worker provenance are not checked transitively
findings.evidence: The parent records requests_sha256 and worker_registration_sha256 for all8 repos. This fitter checks aggregate candidates/NPZ/copy-index hashes, but never validates those per-repo request hashes, worker receipt hashes, worker features schema/profile/generation/inputs/view_receipts, or exact worker-to-aggregate candidate concatenation. Width251 and qid/index checks do not replace that projection/source chain.
findings.impact: The code review can verify the intended worker and frozen251 constants, but the draft alone does not certify that each cached matrix/candidate row was produced by those assets. No mismatch was observed; actual artifacts are not yet reviewed.
findings.required_closure: Bind all8 worker receipts and request files; verify their declared outputs against the copied NPZ and aggregate candidate rows, ordered feature schema251 against the parent, and source registration/generation/model/translation/view receipts against the independently reviewed source phase. Retain those hashes in the pre-fit record.

findings.title: Sum of anchor lengths rejects valid overlapping-anchor references
findings.evidence: The draft requires sum(end-start+1 for each anchor)<=40. The original validate_case permits overlapping anchors and strict scoring checks the union of visible lines; it does not require anchor intervals to be disjoint.
findings.impact: A legitimate reference could fail before preparation/fit even though all its anchors fit the original line budget. This is a conservative false rejection, not relaxed acceptance. Whether the sealed pilot contains such a reference was deliberately not inspected.
findings.required_closure: Assess source/bundle feasibility using the union of required lines and the unchanged physical fragment/JSON limits. Do not drop, rewrite or weaken a reference to satisfy the extra sum rule.
